title: Uniform cohomological bound for oriented nearby cycles
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $f:X\to S$ be a finite-type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] all of whose geometric fibres have dimension at most $d\ge0$, and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring with $m\Lambda=0$ for an integer $m\geq1$ invertible on $S$. For every sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$, $R^i\Psi_fF=0$ for $i>2d$, with $R\Psi$ as in [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. If $K$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$, then $R\Psi_fK$ has cohomology only in $[a,b+2d]$. These bounds hold also after every scheme base change $T\to S$, with $T$ arbitrary (not necessarily Noetherian): for $f_T:X_T\to T$, every sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{T,\mathrm{Et}}$ and every complex on $X_{T,\mathrm{Et}}$ with cohomology in $[a,b]$, with the same $d,a,b$.

source.place: Proposition 2.3, pp. 3--4; bounded-complex consequence by truncation. Local archival PDF WANTED; author PDF read online.
